tool_args.rationale: All five pilot observations are positive and lie at H = 0.16–0.48, whereas the forecast target is H = 24.2. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the response reverses and constrains the late-time magnitude before model confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon points can constrain early curvature without reliably separating the slow amplitude from its time constant; a close pilot fit would not establish the sign at H = 24.2.
It can explain positive early growth but cannot reverse sign from these zero initial states. The pilot does not yet distinguish it from delayed adaptation.
Finer early-time sampling does not directly observe the delayed response that determines the target-horizon forecast.
